facts.text: California Northstate University offers BS-MD Early Assurance Honors Tracks (3+4 and 4+4 pathways) partnering its College of Health Sciences with its College of Medicine, granting conditionally accepted medical school seats to incoming freshmen who meet criteria including a 3.8 unweighted GPA and a 1400 SAT or 31 ACT.

sources.title: BS-MD Early Assurance Honors Track | California Northstate University
sources.quote: The California Northstate University (CNU) Bachelor of Science (BS) to Medical Doctor (MD) Early Assurance Honors Track (BS-MD) is a unique partnership between CNU's College of Health Sciences and College of Medicine .
